description: Famine Early Warning System Network (FEWS NET) is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by USGS, United States Geological Survey. This portal provides access to geospatial data, satellite image products, and derived data products in support of drought monitoring efforts that could give early warning about potential famines throughout the world. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Drought, Extreme Heat, Flooding – General, High Winds. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Economy, People. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
